scope: First generation after a real file-backed explicit import and repair on a synthetic fixture. Native Hatch and production owner APIs, each with and without native budget enrollment.
evidence_level: Offline integration through public APIs, filesystem journals, actual retained ledger and real kernel ownership locks. Artwork, policy and run are fixtures. No provider implementation, network, credentials, real charges or deployment.

frozen_pr_head.diagnostic: First claim after explicit import and repair refused. Native accounting requires the current on-disk owner journal.

comparison_base.method: Same added test module; all implementation and fixture helpers loaded from the comparison base worktree.

positive_contract: After import and explicit repair: pending base, 0 attempts, intact attributed source and repair history, no previous operation or reservation.
First native or production claim has one live attempt with the matching token, current prompt hash and fixture receipt, and retains the complete prior history and original source file.
A budgeted claim has exactly one shared operation/reservation identity, its one token, complete worst-case hold and zero measured expenditure.
Unbudgeted handoffs have no budget operation or reservation. A production owner reports exactly one generation claim.
review_boundary: Evidence covers these four fixture scenarios and the listed revisions. A corrected implementation requires a fresh run and independent review.
